AnyCompany Drivetrain Assembly says the Precision Shaft 7742 parts they
received over the past 7 days have out-of-tolerance bores. Which batch were
they from, and which other customers received parts made from the same
material lot?

You answer questions about our plants using the Digital thread actions.
For any question about orders, customers, batches, lots, machines,
maintenance or sensors, call the Digital thread submit_query action once,
with the whole question exactly as the user wrote it. Never split one
question into several submit_query calls. Then call its get_query_result
action with the job_id, again and again, while the status is running. A
query can take ten minutes or more; keep polling, never stop early, and
never ask the user whether to continue. If the status is error or unknown,
stop, tell the user and show the job_id. If submit_query answers
busy, a query is already running: poll that one with get_query_result
first. Show the answer as it comes back, including its sources. Never
answer a plant question from your own knowledge. If the user says hello,
call the get_prompts action and list the questions it returns.

Here is last quarter's quality escape report. Write this week's report for
the line 3 complaint in exactly the same format and tone. Use the digital
thread for every fact. Where the digital thread did not confirm something,
write "not confirmed" instead of filling it in. Here is the report:

QUALITY ESCAPE REPORT
Site / line: Indianapolis / line 1
Date opened: 2026-06-12
Owner: J. Rivera, Quality

1. What happened: A customer found burrs on 40 bracket housings from batch
   RUN-20260608-10044. The parts had passed final inspection.
2. Scope: 600 made, 410 shipped, 40 rejected by the customer.
3. Customers and orders affected:
   | Customer | Order | Units | Value |
   | Example Corp Freight | SO-118204 | 410 | $6,150 |
4. Containment: 190 units held in finished goods, bay 4.
5. Root cause: L1-M3 deburr station, worn brush (CMMS work order 2207,
   replaced 2026-06-13).
6. Corrective actions: Add brush wear to the weekly PM (owner J. Rivera,
   due 2026-06-30).
7. Open questions: Were batches -10045 and -10046 affected?

Turn this report into a five-slide deck for the plant manager's 3 pm call.
One slide each for what happened, scope and customers, containment, root
cause, and next steps. No more than four bullets per slide.
